---
title: "Leaderboard de Advogados"
description: "Ranking de advogados com base no sistema de pontuação OpenSkill."
output: /data/lawyer_leaderboard.json
format: array
optional: true
---

Leaderboard dos advogados no tribunal com base no rating conservador (mu - 3 * sigma).
Apenas advogados com 20 ou mais casos são incluídos para evitar volatilidade de histórico curto.

```{sql}
SELECT
  lawyer_name,
  oab_number,
  oab_state,
  ROUND(rating, 2) AS rating,
  ROUND(mu, 2) AS mu,
  ROUND(sigma, 2) AS sigma,
  total_cases,
  wins,
  losses,
  ROUND(100.0 * win_rate, 1) AS win_rate
FROM lawyer_ratings
WHERE tribunal = 'TJRO'
  AND total_cases >= 20
ORDER BY rating DESC;
```
